items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Al Killian was still there part of the time. But at that time I think we were using five trumpets... When Killian was in your band did he have those little boxing gloves dangling from his trumpet? Oh, yes. Oh, yes.

ctx.x: But the arrangement was by Andy Gibson, obviously, and the gentleman who really dominates the whole thing was Al Killian, the trumpet player.
Al played with you when, what years?
